title: Selena Gomez Clarifies Golden Globes Conversation, Sets the Record Straight
htmlContent:
Following a buzz-worthy moment captured at the Golden Globes, where Selena Gomez was seen engaged in conversation with friends Taylor Swift and Keleigh Teller, speculations started swirling across social media platforms. The scene sparked widespread assumptions that Gomez was involved in gossiping about fellow celebrities Timothée Chalamet and Kylie Jenner. However, the star has since stepped forward to dispel the rumors and provide context to the conversation.

Amidst the speculation, Selena Gomez took to social media to quash the swirling rumors and clarify the nature of her conversation with Taylor Swift and Keleigh Teller. Responding to an E! News Instagram post addressing the speculation, Gomez left a comment, setting the record straight. "Noooooo I told Taylor about two of my friends who hooked up. Not that that’s [anyone's] business," Gomez shared in her comment, offering insight into the nature of her discussion. A reliable source confirmed to PEOPLE that Gomez's conversation had no connection to Timothée Chalamet or Kylie Jenner.

Contrary to online rumors alleging interactions between Gomez, Chalamet, and Jenner, the source clarified that there were no such encounters at the event. It was asserted that Selena Gomez had neither sought a photo with Timothée Chalamet, nor had any interaction with the actor and his girlfriend, Kylie Jenner. Throughout the Golden Globes evening, Gomez radiated joy, mingling with co-stars and friends, before being spotted with her boyfriend, Benny Blanco, towards the end of the event.

Selena Gomez later shared an Instagram Story showcasing her affection for Blanco, featuring a photo of the couple kissing, captioned, "I won." This public display of affection echoed her happiness, a sentiment that has been celebrated by those close to her. An insider shared with PEOPLE, "Everyone is so happy that she's happy," further emphasizing the protective nature of Gomez's inner circle towards her. The bond between Gomez and Blanco seems to be strong, as evident from Gomez's heartfelt expressions on social media, labeling Blanco as "my absolute everything in my heart" and "the best thing that's ever happened to me."

Gomez's candid revelation not only sheds light on the true nature of her conversation but also underscores the importance of debunking baseless speculations that often circulate in the realm of celebrity culture. Her openness and authenticity serve as a reminder to respect personal boundaries and to refrain from jumping to conclusions based on fleeting moments captured in the public eye.
